chapters.sourceReason: recreation: a push that failed for two stations, which Demo Mode short-circuits and which a live course must never be asked to produce; a Demo Mode take needs the owner's hand sign-in to the demo form and the local capture config and name maps, which this machine does not have, so the guide site's recreation of this step's screen stands in (decided by the executor under owner direction 2026-10-19; for review in person 2026-10-22)
